iree.label: IREE C API runtime diagrams / HAL
iree.type: Original conceptual diagram informed by IREE component diagrams; generic firmware and course roles are additions.

dma.label: Linux DMA mapping guide
dma.type: Original simplified diagram informed by the Linux address-space illustration; no traced artwork.

barriers.label: Linux memory-barrier guide
barriers.type: Original pedagogical ordering diagram informed by the documented memory model; no universal barrier recipe.

otbn.label: OpenTitan OTBN testbench architecture
otbn.type: Original simplified testbench informed by OTBN DV; not a reproduction of its architecture or signoff flow.

twister.label: Zephyr Twister device fixtures
twister.type: Original teaching schematic informed by Twister fixtures and evidence separation; not an accelerator SDK.

telemetry.label: NVIDIA SMI telemetry definitions
telemetry.type: Original measurement schematic; no samples or performance values reproduced.

fault.label: Linux fault-injection methodology + course ABI
fault.type: Original diagram of the course-owned injected faults; Linux documentation supplies methodology, not these modeled IRQ semantics.

abi.label: Course-owned ABI v1
abi.type: Original diagram of the executable course model; not an external vendor ABI.

prompts.label: Course AI task boundaries
prompts.type: Original course experiment design; not an external benchmark result.

explorer.label: Course bounded-state explorer
explorer.type: Original diagram of the course abstract ownership model; not a weak-memory or silicon proof.

target.label: Course target-evidence contract
target.type: Original proposed qualification protocol; hardware execution remains not-run.

capstone.label: Course capstone contract
capstone.type: Original course assessment and artifact design.

figures.name: 00_accelerator_software.html
figures.anchor: One execution stack, explicit boundaries — diagram
figures.anchor_cn: 一条执行栈，明确的边界示意图
figures.title: Host and device execution boundaries
figures.title_cn: 主机与设备的执行边界
figures.caption: Follow command submission down and completion back up.
figures.caption_cn: 沿图向下跟踪提交，再向上跟踪完成。

figures.name: 00_accelerator_software.html
figures.anchor_cn: 功能实验主线
figures.title: One command through the virtual device
figures.title_cn: 一条命令经过虚拟设备
figures.caption: Copy and modulo-256 add-one operate on modeled bytes.
figures.caption_cn: 复制与模 256 加一只操作模型中的字节。

figures.name: 00_accelerator_software.html
figures.anchor_cn: 证据路径
figures.title: Four evidence scopes
figures.title_cn: 四种证据范围
figures.caption: Choose the evidence path that can answer the claim.
figures.caption_cn: 先确定声明，再选择能够回答它的证据路径。

figures.name: 00_accelerator_software.html
figures.anchor_cn: AI 辅助有明确边界
figures.title: Independent proposal and acceptance
figures.title_cn: 提议与验收分别负责
figures.caption: The proposer cannot rewrite the frozen contract.
figures.caption_cn: 候选实现的提议者不能修改已冻结的验收契约。

figures.name: 01_interfaces.html
figures.anchor: A command crosses several contracts — diagram
figures.anchor_cn: 命令跨越多个合同示意图
figures.title: Tensor semantics and command contracts
figures.title_cn: 张量语义与命令契约
figures.caption: Each boundary preserves a different part of the meaning.
figures.caption_cn: 每一层都要保留对应的语义与约束。

figures.name: 01_interfaces.html
figures.anchor_cn: 句柄不是 DMA 地址
figures.title: Two address paths to one RAM buffer
figures.title_cn: 两条地址路径访问同一块 RAM
figures.caption: An integer lab handle is neither a CPU pointer nor a DMA address.
figures.caption_cn: 实验中的整数句柄既不是 CPU 指针，也不是 DMA 地址。

figures.name: 01_interfaces.html
figures.anchor_cn: 一个具体的二进制描述符
figures.title: The 24-byte teaching descriptor
figures.title_cn: 24 字节教学描述符
figures.caption: Little-endian ABI v1. Field widths are drawn to scale.
figures.caption_cn: 小端序 ABI v1；图中各字段按字节宽度绘制。

figures.name: 01_interfaces.html
figures.anchor_cn: 消耗资源之前验证
figures.title: Validation before resource commitment
figures.title_cn: 资源占用之前的验证
figures.caption: Every rejection preserves the original queue and pin ledger.
figures.caption_cn: 任何拒绝路径都应保留原来的队列与固定资源记录。

figures.name: 02_queues_dma.html
figures.anchor_cn: 所有权时间线示意图
figures.title: Ownership across submission and reap
figures.title_cn: 从提交到收取完成的所有权
figures.caption: Device done, host observed and safe reuse are distinct events.
figures.caption_cn: 设备完成、主机观察到完成、安全复用是三个事件。

figures.name: 02_queues_dma.html
figures.anchor_cn: 一个 FIFO worker，有界槽位
figures.title: FIFO service and outstanding slots
figures.title_cn: FIFO 执行与未收取槽位
figures.caption: A completed command keeps its slot until reap.
figures.caption_cn: 已完成的命令仍占用槽位，直到收取完成。

figures.name: 02_queues_dma.html
figures.anchor: Ordering and visibility are separate ideas
figures.anchor_cn: 顺序与可见性是不同概念
figures.title: Output visibility before completion
figures.title_cn: 输出可见性先于完成发布
figures.caption: The CPU model is atomic; a real target needs its documented ordering rules.
figures.caption_cn: CPU 模型采用原子写入；真机需遵守平台的内存序规则。

figures.name: 02_queues_dma.html
figures.anchor_cn: 中断丢失与工作未完成
figures.title: Completed work with a lost interrupt
figures.title_cn: 工作已完成，但中断丢失
figures.caption: Polling can recover notification; timeout alone releases nothing.
figures.caption_cn: 轮询可以补查完成；仅发生超时不会释放资源。

figures.name: 03_firmware_lifecycle.html
figures.anchor_cn: 固件状态转换示意图
figures.title: Firmware states and guarded transitions
figures.title_cn: 固件状态与受条件约束的迁移
figures.caption: Only a supported boot enters READY. Recovery returns through RESET.
figures.caption_cn: 只有受支持的启动才能进入 READY；恢复需经过 RESET。

figures.name: 03_firmware_lifecycle.html
figures.anchor_cn: Watchdog 行为
figures.title: A hung command keeps its buffers
figures.title_cn: 挂起命令继续持有缓冲区
figures.caption: Watchdog expiry enters FAULT; pins survive until recovery.
figures.caption_cn: 看门狗到期后进入 FAULT；恢复之前继续固定缓冲区。

figures.name: 03_firmware_lifecycle.html
figures.anchor_cn: Reset 首先要建立静止状态
figures.title: Quiescence before memory reclamation
figures.title_cn: 确认设备静止后再回收内存
figures.caption: Atomic quiesce/reset is a teaching-model assumption.
figures.caption_cn: 原子静止化与复位是教学模型的假设。

figures.name: 03_firmware_lifecycle.html
figures.anchor_cn: 拒绝旧完成事件
figures.title: Same cookie, different generation
figures.title_cn: 相同 cookie，不同代次
figures.caption: Generation rejects old events; it cannot stop physical DMA writes.
figures.caption_cn: 代次能拒绝旧事件，却不能停止实际的 DMA 写入。

figures.name: 04_runtime_lifetimes.html
figures.anchor: Three actors share one contract — diagram
figures.anchor_cn: 三个参与者共享一个合同示意图
figures.title: Runtime, driver interface and device
figures.title_cn: Runtime、驱动接口与设备
figures.caption: The Python model combines these roles; a real driver must implement their contracts.
figures.caption_cn: Python 模型合并了这些职责；真实驱动需实现对应契约。

figures.name: 04_runtime_lifetimes.html
figures.anchor_cn: 固定所有权在入队后继续存在
figures.title: Exclusive buffer ownership
figures.title_cn: 缓冲区的独占所有权
figures.caption: Both source and destination remain pinned until safe reap or quiesced reset.
figures.caption_cn: 源与目标缓冲区都要固定到安全收取完成或静止复位。

figures.name: 04_runtime_lifetimes.html
figures.anchor_cn: 取消不是一种统一操作
figures.title: Cancellation depends on command state
figures.title_cn: 取消操作取决于命令状态
figures.caption: In-flight cancellation is deliberately unsupported in this model.
figures.caption_cn: 本模型明确不支持取消已在执行中的命令。

figures.name: 04_runtime_lifetimes.html
figures.anchor: Reap is part of the interface
figures.anchor_cn: 收取完成也是接口的一部分
figures.title: Completion, observation and reclamation
figures.title_cn: 完成、观察与资源回收
figures.caption: Reap releases the slot and pins exactly once.
figures.caption_cn: 收取完成只释放一次槽位与固定资源。

figures.name: 05_verification.html
figures.anchor: Several evidence methods complement each other — diagram
figures.anchor_cn: 多种证据方法互补示意图
figures.title: Stimulus, reference and independent checks
figures.title_cn: 激励、参考模型与独立检查
figures.caption: Conceptual testbench inspired by OpenTitan OTBN DV; no RTL target is implemented here.
figures.caption_cn: 参考 OpenTitan OTBN 验证结构；本课没有实现 RTL 目标。

figures.name: 05_verification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 验证判定器本身
figures.title: Controls that test the evaluator
figures.title_cn: 用对照检查验收器
figures.caption: A useful evaluator accepts legal changes and rejects broken ones.
figures.caption_cn: 有效的验收器既能接受合法变更，也能拒绝错误实现。

figures.name: 05_verification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 在明确边界注入故障
figures.title: Faults at different execution boundaries
figures.title_cn: 在不同执行边界注入故障
figures.caption: The injection point determines the required recovery evidence.
figures.caption_cn: 注入位置决定必须收集哪一种恢复证据。

figures.name: 05_verification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 有界所有权模型
figures.title: The two-action ownership counterexample
figures.title_cn: 两步即可触发的所有权反例
figures.caption: Depth one misses submit + release; state the search bound.
figures.caption_cn: 深度一无法发现“提交后释放”；需要说明搜索边界。

figures.name: 06_qualification.html
figures.anchor: Promotion needs an evidence matrix — diagram
figures.anchor_cn: 晋级需要证据矩阵示意图
figures.title: Functional pass and missing target evidence
figures.title_cn: 功能通过与目标证据缺失
figures.caption: Use separate status cells for identity, functional, device and physical evidence.
figures.caption_cn: 分别记录身份、功能、设备与物理证据的状态。

figures.name: 06_qualification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 先从一台可恢复测试板开始
figures.title: One board, a runner and a recovery path
figures.title_cn: 一块板卡、执行器与恢复路径
figures.caption: Fixture matching follows the Twister example; accelerator deployment remains vendor-specific.
figures.caption_cn: 参考 Twister 匹配测试夹具；加速器部署仍取决于厂商。

figures.name: 06_qualification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 物理观察需要仪器
figures.title: Power boundary and measurement window
figures.title_cn: 功率边界与测量窗口
figures.caption: Schematic P(t), not measured data. Match completed work and sensor scope.
figures.caption_cn: P(t) 为示意曲线，并非实测数据；要对齐完成工作与传感器范围。

figures.name: 06_qualification.html
figures.anchor_cn: 回滚也有状态合同
figures.title: A safe rollback boundary
figures.title_cn: 安全回滚的边界
figures.caption: Old device access must stop before memory or artifacts are replaced.
figures.caption_cn: 替换内存或产物之前，必须确认旧设备访问已停止。

figures.name: 07_capstone.html
figures.anchor_cn: 综合项目证据链示意图
figures.title: The capstone decision and its evidence
figures.title_cn: 综合项目决策与对应证据
figures.caption: Every claim points to a contract, raw evidence and a reproducible artifact.
figures.caption_cn: 每个声明都要关联契约、原始证据与可复现产物。

figures.name: 07_capstone.html
figures.anchor_cn: 选择有边界的问题
figures.title: A bounded patch inside the stack
figures.title_cn: 执行栈中的一个有界修改
figures.caption: Choose one boundary and name the guarantees you will preserve.
figures.caption_cn: 选择一个边界，并说明需要保留哪些保证。

figures.name: 07_capstone.html
figures.anchor_cn: 可信基线与对照
figures.title: A shared evaluator for baseline and candidate
figures.title_cn: 基线与候选共用一个验收器
figures.caption: Freeze held-out inputs and retain the rejected control.
figures.caption_cn: 冻结留出输入，并保留被拒绝的错误对照。

figures.name: 07_capstone.html
figures.anchor_cn: 交付包
figures.title: The reproducible artifact package
figures.title_cn: 可复现的交付包
figures.caption: A manifest connects code, tests, raw results and the release decision.
figures.caption_cn: 清单把代码、测试、原始结果与发布决策连接起来。
